title: SkyWindow: Drone Windows

candidates.name: Drone Weather
candidates.why: Negative control: it is the generic phrase used throughout the measured shelf.

candidates.name: SkyWindow: Drone Windows
candidates.why: Chosen: it states the product output while retaining a short carrier.

candidates.name: FlyWindow
candidates.why: Short and memorable, but it loses the explicit drone job noun and collision headroom is unmeasured.

candidates.name: Clear Launch
candidates.why: It suggests a verdict but could be confused with airspace clearance, which the product must not claim.

candidates.name: AeroWindow
candidates.why: It sounds aviation-specific but does not state the drone-planning output users search for.

rejected.name: Clear Launch
rejected.reason: It risks promising a launch authorisation or airspace clearance when the app only provides a weather advisory.

rejected.name: Drone Weather
rejected.reason: The measured shelf already uses Drone Weather Forecast, Drone Weather and Drone Weather Map, so the bare category phrase is not distinguishable.

collisions.playSearch: MEASURED: the 2026-10-08 Play title scan for drone flight conditions shows multiple generic Drone Weather titles but no SkyWindow title in its 30 visible cards; a clean result is not trademark clearance.
trademarkScreen: EUIPO eSearch plus / TMview not queried
WIPO Global Brand Database not queried

audience: A recreational drone pilot deciding whether a nearby launch location has a weather-suitable flight window before travelling there.
rationale: SkyWindow: Drone Windows pairs the measured search language with a named product output, while avoiding names that imply legal clearance or repeat the shelf's generic Drone Weather title pattern.
collisionCheck: MEASURED: the 2026-10-08 title scan shows no SkyWindow title in 30 visible drone-flight-condition cards; this is not trademark clearance because no register was queried.
localisationCheck: The 24-character Latin title leaves six characters of slack below Play's 30-character cap in en-US and ru-RU; discoverability in ru-RU remains unverified.
assumptionsUnverified: SkyWindow trademark headroom in class 9 is unverified because no trademark register was queried.
The English title's discoverability for Russian-speaking users has not been measured.
